verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's agent-driven automations (Insights-based performance fixes) are designed to open pull requests on a recurring schedule, giving natural version control and human review via git (docs-20, docs-31, docs-42). Rollback isn't directly tied to these agent actions but is supported generally through branch reverts, deploy requests, and backups (docs-11, docs-27, docs-33, docs-35). missing for 10: explicit documentation of rolling back or auditing an agent-initiated change specifically, and a dedicated automation history/versioning UI.
